traits.name: methodical
traits.reason: Shift summaries count legs walked and wood stored, but no unproven build was tested and no cost, result or order of operations was recorded.

traits.name: observant
traits.reason: No line names a structure's type, purpose or parts; the moves show travel but no noted structures.

traits.name: generous
traits.reason: Offered 20 wood to Clarion and posts shift summaries, but shares no findings and credits nobody for a build.

traits.name: plain_spoken
traits.reason: Lines are short and lead with numbers (15 wood, 30 wood, 9 legs, coordinates), but they say nothing of cost or purpose and have no dry aside.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: Steady repeated walking and gathering with regular eating; no improvising, but no half-built test is noted either.

traits.name: curious
traits.reason: No questions about what any structure is for; the only exchange is a greeting.
